title: Fillet corner caps tessellate without a stitch step
summary: stitch_ring_to_boundary matched dense ring vertices to the dense great-circle boundary by their angle around cap_dir, but the boundary isn't constant-latitude — it's three arcs that dip closer to the pole between the trim points. The angular match left zigzag stitch slivers and confused face-pick. Replace the constant-latitude rings + stitch with rings whose topology mirrors the boundary's: every interior ring is the boundary slerped toward the pole, so the cap is one clean quad-strip stack from pole to boundary with no stitch step.
